data.title: Franck Muller Aeternitas Tower
data.about:
Dubai is set to break a new record with the Franck Muller Aeternitas Tower, the world's tallest residential clock tower. The Swiss luxury watch manufacturer Franck Muller has collaborated with London Gate,  one of the top real estate developers in the UAE, to add another jewel to Dubai's skyline. The Franck Muller Aeternitas Apartments will be the brand's premier venture into real estate, adding a new dimension to its portfolio.

Located in the opulent community of Dubai Marina, this architectural marvel will soar to 450 meters (106 floors), showcasing the best Swiss artistry and precision. Providing upscale residences ranging from 1 to 4 bedrooms, including Sky Villas, the tower will accommodate 649 units.

The tower will set new standards for luxury living with breathtaking ocean, marina, and golf views. The grand reveal of this mega-residential endeavor is scheduled for January 9, 2024, at Ritz-Carlton DIFC, with residents anticipating its completion and handover by 2026. The name of the upcoming clock tower draws inspiration from the renowned Franck Muller watch of the same name, acclaimed as the world's most intricate timepiece.

characteristics_module.title: Inspired by the Frank Muller Diamond Watch
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Setting international standards for high-end living
  • Located in the heart of the city, Dubai Marina
  • Inspired by the most expensive watch by Frank Muller
  • The Swiss watchmaking company's first real estate project
  • Dubai's first residential clock tower
  • The first and tallest branded residential clock tower in the world
  • The second clock tower in Dubai, after Deira Clock Tower, built in 1965
  • Offering residents spectacular views of the marina, ocean, and golf course

location_tile.title: The Ultimate Apartments in Dubai Marina
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Franck Muller Aeternitas Apartments will be located in Dubai Marina, a well-known waterfront neighborhood in the city. This artificial canal city is one of the region's most sought-after residential and leisure destinations. A project of Emaar Properties, Dubai Marina offers modern urban living and luxurious amenities.

The futuristic tower will be located amidst an array of eateries, cafés, retail stores, and entertainment venues. The marina itself will offer residents opportunities for boat cruises and water-based activities.

  • 06 mins – Jumeirah Beach Residence
  • 10 mins – Jumeirah Lake Towers
  • 10 mins – Palm Jumeirah
  • 22 mins – Business Bay
